hotspots.title: Polygon Perimeters
hotspots.popover_content: Equilateral Triangle = 3s, Square = 4s, Regular Pentagon = 5s, Regular Hexagon = 6s.

hotspots.title: Matchstick Square Rule
hotspots.popover_content: Building w connected squares requires 3w + 1 matchsticks (1st square takes 4, each added takes 3).

hotspots.title: Endless 4-Column Grid Formula
hotspots.popover_content: Number N in row r, col c: N = 4(r - 1) + c = 4r - 4 + c. 143 lies in Row 36, Column 3.

hotspots.title: Combining Like Terms
hotspots.popover_content: Like terms share identical variables: 5y + 2y = 7y. Unlike terms (3x + 4y) cannot be merged.
